name: Fel Cone: the lootable cone is an invisible size 1 chest beside a decorative cone (#365)
contract: Report #365: the quest sparkle of a Fel Cone in Teldrassil is far too big.

Live CoA gameobject caches (2026-09-04..09) and the SUB dump (2026-10-04) give Fel Cone 1673 type 3 with the invisible-cube display 980926 at size 1, and a separate decorative Fel Cone 661673 type 5 with display 425 at size 2.5; the ascension-data catalogue places a 661673 at 1673 spawn 49746 (9303.36, 763.68).
At that spawn a Night Elf on Seek Redemption! (489) sees one lootable 1673 that is active for the quest and one decorative 661673 beside it.
A 1673 chest uses display 980926 at scale 1 and still yields the quest-only Fel Cone (3418), so the quest stays obtainable.
